Open fracture care: 3

Choose the single best answer, then reveal the explanation.

After wound assessment, an open fracture remains mechanically unstable. The treatment plan includes a method to maintain alignment and support wound care and healing. Which essential principle addresses this mechanical component of treatment?

  1. Planned viable soft-tissue coverage
  2. Assess tetanus protection
  3. Fracture stabilization
  4. Prompt appropriate intravenous antibiotics
  5. Surgical debridement
Reveal answer and explanation
Correct answer

Fracture stabilization

Mechanical stabilization supports alignment, soft-tissue care and healing.

Understanding the options

Fracture stabilization
Mechanical stabilization supports alignment, soft-tissue care and healing.
Prompt appropriate intravenous antibiotics
Open-fracture antibiotics should begin promptly according to local protocol and injury contamination; they do not replace surgery. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.
Surgical debridement
Contaminated and nonviable tissue must be assessed and removed to reduce infection risk. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.
Planned viable soft-tissue coverage
Exposed bone or hardware may require coordinated reconstructive coverage after adequate debridement. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.
Assess tetanus protection
Tetanus prophylaxis depends on wound characteristics and immunization history. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.
